svg.aria-label: The /mf-plan mixture-of-agents workflow: a prompt fans out to up to five read-only proposer models, a synthesizer reconciles their plans into one, the human approves or loops back to refine (up to five rounds), an implementer builds in-session, and a verifier judges the result — passing, or looping findings back to the implementer for up to two repair rounds
svg.text: up to 5 models plan independently · one synthesizer reconciles · you approve
proposers never see each other · disagreements become your decision · the verifier never writes code
